home.aboutText: Inzu Ndangamurage ya Kandt, iri i Kigali mu Rwanda, iri mu nzu yahoze ari iy'umuganga Richard Kandt — umutegetsi wa mbere w'Abadage mu Rwanda. Ubu ikora nk'inzu ndangamurage y'amateka kamere igaragaza ubudasa bw'ibinyabuzima bya Rwanda, umurage w'isi, n'inkuru y'uko Kigali yashinzwe. Inzu ndangamurage ibika ikusanyirizo ry'inyamaswa, ibimera, amabuye y'agaciro, n'ibikoresho by'amateka bivuga inkuru y'ihindagurika ry'umuco n'ibidukikije bya Rwanda.
home.historyText: Yubatswe mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya 20, inzu ihagaze nk'imwe mu nyubako za kera z'igihe cy'abakoloni i Kigali. Nyuma y'ubwigenge, yahinduwe ikaba ahantu ho kubika umurage kamere wa Rwanda. Ubu inzu ndangamurage irimo amamurikiro akoreshwa na AR azana amateka mu buzima ku bashyitsi b'ubu.

home.trailsDesc: Kurikira inzira ziteguwe muikusanyirizo ry'inzu ndangamurage — buri nzira igukuyobora mu rugendo rwo gushakisha.
home.collectionsDesc: Shakisha ikusanyirizo esheshatu rinini rikubiyemo amateka y'umuco, politiki, ubukoloni n'ibinyabuzima byu Rwanda — byose bibitswe mu nkuta z'inzu ya Dr Richard Kandt.
home.notableArtifactsDesc: Ikarita n'inyandiko z'igihe cy'ubukoloni, amafoto y'amateka y'ibihe by'Abadage n'Ababirigi, ibikoresho byo guhinga no mu rugo, ubugeni bw'umuco, ibinyabuzima, ikusanyirizo ry'amabuye, n'imishushanyo y'ingo z'ubwami.
home.livingHeritageDesc: Usibye ikusanyirizo ryayo, inzu ndangamurage ikora nk'ahantu ho guhana umuco, gahunda z'uburezi, no kwifatanya n'abaturage — kugirango imigenzo y'u Rwanda ikomeze kubaho ku bana b'ejo.
home.collPreColonialDesc: Amazu y'umuco, ubugeni, imyambaro, umuziki, imbyino, ubuhinzi n'ubworozi — bigaragaza uko abanyarwanda babayeho kandi babitse imigenzo yabo kuva kera.
home.collKingdomDesc: Kimwe mu bihugu byari biteguye cyane mbere y'ubukoloni muri Afurika — Umwami, itorero ry'ubwami, imiryango, uburyo bwo gutegeka, no guhuza ubwami.
home.collGermanDesc: Amateka ya Dr Richard Kandt, ubushakashatsi bw'Abadage mu Rwanda, ishyirwaho ry'ubutegetsi bw'ubukoloni, n'imigenderanire n'ubwami bw'u Rwanda — bisobanurwa n'ikarita, amafoto n'inyandiko.
home.collBelgianDesc: Ubutegetsi bw'Ababirigi, kwaguka kw'ubumisinari, politiki z'indangamuntu, gutonya amoko, imikurire y'imigambwe, n'inzira y'u Rwanda igana ubwigenge mu 1962.
home.collNatureDesc: Imiterere y'amabuye y'u Rwanda, ikibaya cya Albertine, uturere tw'ibirunga, ibimera byo mu gihugu, ibinyabuzima, no kubungabunga ibidukikije — guhuza kamere n'umuryango.
home.collModernDesc: Ihinduka nyuma y'ubwigenge, Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yo mu 1994, ubumwe bw'igihugu n'ubwiyunge, no kubaka no guhindura u Rwanda ku buryo butangaje.
home.heroTagline: Menya Urugendo rw'u Rwanda mu Mateka, Umuco, n'Ikoranabuhanga
home.heroStory: Injira mu mazu y'umurage akomeye ya Kigali — aho amateka kamere y'u Rwanda, igihe cy'ubukoloni, n'umwirondoro w'umuco wihariye birinzwe kandi bikaba bizima binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga rishya.
home.heroImageSub: Inzu yari iy'a Dr. Richard Kandt
home.experiencesDesc: Kuva ku ikoranabuhanga rya AR kugeza ku mayobora — injira mu murage w'u Rwanda binyuze mu bikorwa by'ikoranabuhanga.
home.expARDesc: Ereka kamera yawe ibyo mwerekana kugirango ufungure ibicuruzwa bya 3D, inkuru zivugwa, n'ibintu by'amateka.
home.expToursDesc: Kurikira inzira ziyobowe n'impuguke mu nzu ndangamurage hamwe n'ibisobanuro byinshi.
home.expExhibitionsDesc: Shakisha imurikagurisha ryihariye rigizwe n'ibikoresho, inkuru, na menya n'ijwi n'amashusho.
home.expArchivesDesc: Reba ibibitswe byose mu nzu ndangamurage — ibikoresho, ibinyabuzima, inyandiko, n'amafoto.
home.entryDesc: Soma kode QR kugirango utangire uburambe bwawe — nta porogaramu ikenewe.
home.entryScan: Soma na kamera ya telefoni yawe
home.timelineDesc: Shakisha ibihe by'ingenzi byashyize u Rwanda mu mwanya — kuva ku bwami bwa kera kugeza ku gihugu gishya cy'ikoranabuhanga.
home.eraAncientDesc: Mbere y'uko Abanyaburayi baza, u Rwanda rwari rufite amatsinda yateganyijwe neza afite imico myiza y'ubuhinzi, imyizerere, n'imibereho myiza.
home.eraKingdomDesc: Ubwami bw'u Rwanda, buyobowe na Mwami, bwabaye bumwe mu bihugu by'Afurika byari bifite ubutegetsi buteganijwe — hamwe n'urugo rw'umwami, ingabo, n'ubutegetsi.
home.eraColonialDesc: Ubwa mbere mu Budage (1897–1916) hanyuma mu Bubiligi (1916–1962), u Rwanda rwagize ubutegetsi bw'abakoloni bwahinduye imibereho — Dr. Richard Kandt yashyizeho Kigali nk'umurwa mukuru uva muri iyi nzu.
home.eraIndependenceDesc: U Rwanda rwabonye ubwigenge mu 1962, rutangira igihe gikomeye cyo kubaka igihugu gifite intambwe n'ibibazo bikomeye.
home.eraModernDesc: Nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yo mu 1994, u Rwanda rwatangiye urugendo rutangaje rw'ubumwe, ubwiyunge, no guhinduka — rubaye rumwe mu bihugu by'Afurika bikura vuba.
home.cultureDesc: Umurage muzima w'u Rwanda — imico, ubuhanzi, n'ibitangaza kamere bigaragaza Igihugu cy'Imisozi Igihumbi.
home.cultureAgasekeDesc: Uduseke tw'amahoro twakoze neza twagaragaza ubumwe n'ubwiyunge — umuco w'u Rwanda wemejwe na UNESCO.
home.cultureImigongoDesc: Amashusho y'umuco akozwe mu mase y'inka mu burasirazuba bw'u Rwanda, afite imiterere igaragara mu mabara y'ubutaka.
home.cultureConservationDesc: Kwiyemeza kw'u Rwanda ku kubungabunga ibidukikije — kuva ku kurinda ingagi z'imisozi kugeza ku iterambere rirambye.
home.cultureBiodiversityDesc: Ahantu h'ingagi z'imisozi, inyoni zitandukanye, n'ibinyabuzima bidasanzwe mu birunga, ibiyaga, n'amashyamba.
home.ctaDesc: Teganya urugendo rwawe cyangwa urebe ibibitswe byacu by'ikoranabuhanga uva aho uri hose ku isi.
